Table 1: Students' response to major factors affecting they're practicing fluency in English speaking at home .

| No.   | Questions                                                                     | Variables                           |   Number of responses | Proportion   |
|-------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------|-----------------------|--------------|
|       | What are the major problems affecting your English speaking practice at home? | Lack of partner                     |                    11 | 36.66 %      |
|       | What are the major problems affecting your English speaking practice at home? | Lack of time                        |                     8 | 26.66 %      |
|       | What are the major problems affecting your English speaking practice at home? | Lack of excellent study environment |                    11 | 36.66 %      |
| Total |                                                                               |                                     |                    30 | 100%         |

It is firmly noticeable that having a lack of a partner to practice speaking and having a lack of an excellent study environment were the main problems which students encountered when studied at home; followed by 11 (36.66%) and 11 (36.66%). Besides that; the figure for having a lack of time for practicing speaking at home was just approximately 27%. This represented having a lack of partners & excellent study environment were factors affecting the ability of oral fluency in English speaking of AVII3 students. they key

Table 2: Students respond to how often practice speaking skills by following methods such as reading books; watching movies; and writing paragraphs. they

| No.   | Questions                                                                                                                      | Variables   |   Number of responses | Proportion   |
|-------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|-----------------------|--------------|
|       | How often do you practice speaking skills by following methods such as reading books, watching movies; and writing paragraphs? | Always      |                    12 | 40 %         |
|       | How often do you practice speaking skills by following methods such as reading books, watching movies; and writing paragraphs? | Sometimes   |                     8 | 26.66 %      |
|       | How often do you practice speaking skills by following methods such as reading books, watching movies; and writing paragraphs? | Never       |                    10 | 33.33 %      |
| Total |                                                                                                                                |             |                    30 | 100%         |

As the information depicted in the above table, 12 (40%) and 10 (33.33%) students always answered and never; respectively. Plus; eight students who spent lack of time for those activities was just around 26.66%. Indeed, these figures led to the imbalance between helpful activities on the   student's   oral   fluency improvement.
